observations.result: The shared IPC contract, Node main process, sandboxed preload and browser renderer compile with strict TypeScript checking.

The local Electron package attempted to download electron-v44.3.0-darwin-arm64.zip and reached 9%; it was interrupted before a visible window opened, so visible launch/accessibility automation remains pending.

implemented: Added shared, validated IPC contracts for Chronicle review, read-only diff, Git history, local recovery records, revision-aware restore and selective commit.
Registered the Chronicle/recovery handlers in Electron main and exposed them through the context-isolated, sandboxed preload without granting renderer filesystem access.
Added visible workspace controls for Review changes, path selection, staged/working diff inspection, read-only history, current-note restore and explicit selected-path commit.
Preserved Git porcelain status columns at the command boundary so modified paths retain their first character, and added regression coverage for sorted changed-path review and app-private exclusion.
Kept the local-first visual system disciplined with sentence-case labels, visible keyboard focus, responsive tool panels and reduced-motion handling.
limitations: The Electron binary was unavailable locally, so no visible launch, accessibility-tree or cross-platform UI automation was completed.
Live remote pull/push, pull conflict resolution, retention-file deletion wiring, uninstall cleanup UI, named external sync-tool certification and reference Obsidian reopen tests remain pending.
P2.2 live preview/reading mode, tabs/splits, command palette, quick switcher, outline/backlinks and settings persistence remain pending.
